items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: There's another band from around New York, the band from Charlie Small's, from Small's Paradise. Those bands used to come through.

ctx.x: And they all would come through Washington. Washington was one, you know, wasn't far from New York, and lot of the top groups would come through there. There's another band from around New York, the band from Charlie
Small's, from Small's Paradise. Those bands used to come through.

But the -- the big name bands at that time were Fletcher, Duke, Chick Webb. They were the big bands that came out of New York, and they would come to Washington quite -- quite frequently. This is -- this goes back, you know, '28-29. That's a long time ago, you know.
